rounds.method: subagent matcher simulation: agent viewed the four live frontmatter descriptions (stack-selection, how-to-golang, library-deep-dive, go-ecosystem-upgrade) and picked one skill or NONE per query, queries pre-shuffled

results.should_trigger_hits: 10/10 — every inception/re-align phrasing fired stack-selection, incl. typo ('sdk's'), lowercase casual ('gonna scaffold'), and the re-align case ('deps accumulated randomly, want a record of it')
results.near_miss_correct_negatives: 10/10 — stack-selection never fired on per-decision policy (testify/ginkgo, viper/koanf → how-to-golang), utilization audits (→ library-deep-dive), version bumps (→ go-ecosystem-upgrade), module shaping, per-SDK wiring, performance, generic third-party questions

rounds.decision: perfect score at round 1 → plateau reached, description unchanged, rounds 2-3 skipped per stop-when-plateau rule (running them would be ritual, not measurement)

known_limits: single matcher simulation, single run (no 3x stability sampling this iteration — the 20/20 margin and the unambiguous routing comments make variance unlikely, but a future iteration may sample 3x per query per skill-creator guidance)
